posts.title: Using Val.town as a webhook middleware
posts.description: My latest obsession has been optimising webhook events from Ghost to Netlify. I needed a way to filter out large payloads sent to Netlify. Using Val.town as a webhook middleware, I can strip payloads and skip triggering builds for certain posts.
